items.title: Is Abbott Laboratories (ABT) Undervalued On New Device And Test Launches?
items.summary: Abbott Laboratories (ABT) has been back in focus after two health focused product milestones. The firm secured FDA and CE approvals for its UltiSynq defibrillation lead and launched the Panbio COVID-19/Flu A&B Self-Test in Canada. Despite a stream of new device approvals and test launches, Abbott Laboratories’ share price has slipped about 12% year to date. A 7.34% 1 month share price return suggests short term momentum is picking up, even as the 1 year total shareholder return is still down...

items.title: Warren Buffett Says His Favorite Holding Period Is Forever. A Secretary Who Paid $180 for 3 Shares in 1935 and Never Sold Died Worth $7 Million. Here’s What Her Rule Does for $600,000 in One Stock Today
items.summary: Warren Buffett's favorite holding period is forever. Grace Groner, a secretary at Abbott, paid $180 for three shares in 1935, reinvested every dividend, never sold, and left Lake Forest College $7 million when she died at 100 in 2010. Here is what the splits did, what the dividends did, what the S&P 500 would have paid, the fall she sat through at 93, and what her rule does for a retired couple holding $600,000 of one old stock today.
